title: ecosanctuary 0.1.0
text: Added portable CSV question-index format folder--index scaffolding. Added complete-bank validation metadata, fragments, chunk labels, variable prefixes, solution blocks, answer helpers. Added explicit, filtered, reproducible random question selection. Added Moodle XML, student HTML/PDF, teacher HTML/PDF, selection-manifest generation. Added numerical, short-answer, single-choice, multiple-choice helpers. Added example bank, reference documentation, vignettes, tests, CI.
